key_insight: AutoSciBench automatically generates and continuously refines scientific benchmarks so they stay challenging as agent capabilities improve.
engineering_relevance: For AI materials science workflows, it offers a way to create more robust evaluations that better expose shortcut solving and real scientific reasoning failures.
method: Represent each task as a high-level concept plus a low-level recipe for question, environment, and answer construction.
Use solver trajectories and judge feedback to revise concepts/recipes and close shortcuts.
Reuse experience from completed refinements to guide new benchmark generation.
evidence_signal: On generated benchmarks, average solver accuracy dropped by 25.5 percentage points in materials science relative to the human-curated benchmarks, with higher average quality ratings across all three domains.
watch_item: Benchmark quality depends on the reliability of automated refinement and judging, so errors or bias in the feedback loop could propagate into the generated tasks.
paper_title: AutoSciBench: Autonomous Benchmark Generation for Evaluating Scientific Agents
